title: Stainless steel plate, sheet and strip - Specification (Second Revision)
clause_1_scope: This standard covers the requirements, tolerances, test methods, and compliance specifications for Stainless steel plate, sheet and strip - Specification (Second Revision) as prescribed under IS 6911 by the Bureau of Indian Standards.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Code for designation of steels, Part I Based on lettter symbols
Indian Standard Code of Practice / Test Method (IS 1762)

marking_requirements: Each product/package must bear the manufacturer's name, trademark, and grade.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS ISI Mark) subject to licensing.
